label: Settings
tagline: Wallpaper, colours and how Forge looks

help.about: How Forge looks: the theme (light or dark), the wallpaper, the font and the text size. Reset puts any of it back the way it started.

actions.words: speaker output microphone mute loud quiet

features.name: Wallpaper
features.description: Follow the desktop's wallpaper or pick one from ~/Pictures/Wallpapers (sub-folders too), with the Wallpapers app's favourites. The current picture's thumbnail shows even when the desktop's picture lives outside the folder.

features.name: Colour
features.description: The accent taken from the wallpaper's own palette, or one picked by hand.

features.name: Every Forge setting by section
features.description: One card per group of shared/forge_theme.py's table, as a sidebar, tabs or one long page; search, pinned sections, compact or comfortable, sliders paired with number fields.

features.name: Changed from default
features.description: One view of every setting changed from its default, counted under the search box; each changed row, Forge keys included, has a back-to-default button.

features.name: System
features.description: The laptop's own settings: auto-close rules, sound, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, display, battery, notifications, date and time (system_settings/panels.json). Bluetooth switched off at the radio says so and has a Turn Bluetooth on button.

features.name: Resets in layers
features.description: A reset at the foot of every page and System panel, groups of settings that belong together (visual effects, power, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth with forget steps, look, shortcuts, auto-close), and Reset all settings in About. Each asks first, keeps a copy and has Undo; the Business lock guards them.

features.name: Pick for my machine
features.description: Reads the CPU, graphics, memory, battery and power limits and picks a visual effect level and a power choice for Forge, Forge Desktop or both.
